label: Trade terms (Incoterms)
text: BU.O.A5.1 Trade terms — Incoterms 2020 (ICC, eleven rules) allocate delivery tasks, costs and the passing of risk between seller and buyer. They do not allocate title. Title passes under the sale contract and the governing law (LA).

warrant.standard: stated rule (ICC, OECD, HS); legal force before a forum
